title: How Antibiotics Work
text: Antibiotics are medications that treat bacterial infections by killing bacteria or inhibiting their growth, typically by targeting structures or processes unique to bacterial cells, such as cell wall synthesis or protein production. Antibiotics are not effective against viral infections, such as the common cold or flu. Overuse and misuse of antibiotics contribute to antibiotic resistance, a growing public health concern; they should only be used as prescribed by a healthcare professional.
